CleanAir provides ductFIT air purification products and KleanSense indoor air quality monitoring for Dubai and the UAE.

Chosen around how
you use your space.

Our range brings together portable devices, standalone systems, wall and ceiling installation options, and HVAC-integrated units. KleanSense adds environmental monitoring to help you understand indoor conditions.

Our analyze, create and execute approach starts with indoor conditions, then brings together appropriate equipment, monitoring and installation. Discuss baseline assessment, dashboard setup and a review after installation as part of your project.

Meet your solution

How we approach a project

Clear choices from the start.

01

Analyze your environment

Understand the space, occupancy and existing HVAC conditions. Use monitoring or third-party IAQ testing when a project needs baseline data.

02

Create your IAQ plan

Compare appropriate purification formats, monitoring locations and any ventilation or humidity support required by the space.

03

Execute and review

Install and configure the selected equipment, set up data access, and review indoor conditions after installation.

Support around the equipment

From first readings
to a working plan.

Bring monitoring, purification and the practical details of your building into one conversation.

Connected monitoring

View live readings and historical trends in a centralised dashboard. Discuss sensor locations, reporting, alerts and BMS integration options for your project.

Installation and setup

Plan the equipment layout, installation and connectivity. Include Wi-Fi configuration, access to readings and handover requirements in the project scope.

Before-and-after assessment

Discuss third-party IAQ testing before and after installation. A site-specific sampling plan can include particles, gases, and bacterial or fungal counts.

For the proposal review

A clearer website for CleanAir.

Accurate and focused

Authentic product images, relevant company copy and no unrelated landscaping reviews. Product pages explain model distinctions and clearly label model-specific technical references.

A useful enquiry journey

A product finder and prefilled enquiries give visitors a clear starting point. WhatsApp messages stay drafts until the visitor presses Send.

Prepared for a public launch

Separate HTML pages, unique metadata, canonical URLs, structured data and a sitemap. This proposal is private and excluded from indexing; production configuration enables indexing.
